output.body:
This issue is the scaling account of `gandr check` on the wide host (#6879). `mise run bench:scaling` adds one row for each head of `main` that it measures, the newest first.

- A cell of the curve gives the median wall time of three runs of `gandr check --recheck crates/surface-corpus/strict library/std`, and the speed-up against one thread. Its column names the threads and the NUMA nodes of the point.
- The placement column gives the median of three runs at 16 threads on the nodes that it names. Compare it with the cell of the same width on fewer nodes.
- The hotpath column gives the wall time of one run of the `gandr` hotpath series at each width of the curve, on the same nodes.
- The host reads `held` while a mutation run holds the wide host. The account never compares such a row.
- A row whose speed-up at 64 threads is 20 % or more below that of the newest `idle` row before it is a fall. A fall opens a defect, and its row reads `fixed` once the defect closes.
